newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Keppel to pump more funds into Monte bank.
newsitem.headline: Keppel to pump more funds into Monte bank.

text.p: The Keppel Group said on Tuesday it would put more funds into the ailing Monte de Piedad & Savings Bank of the Philippines on top of the 2.5 billion pesos it has already committed to rehabilitate the bank.
The Keppel Group has deposited one billion pesos with the Central Bank last May 5 to acquire 60 percent stake in Monte which was closed two weeks ago due after a run on its deposits.
Another 1.5 billion pesos have been committed by Keppel to rehabilitate the bank which has bad debts worth 1.8 billion pesos.
"Keppel Group has also committed to make available additional resources, as required, to grow the presence of Monte de Piedad in the Philippines," Keppel said in a statement.
It said it would open six more branches within one and a half years. Monte currently operates 31 branches.
